explanation: The Almighty Creator who has promised an eternal inheritance to believers.
A holy guarantee from God of future blessing, especially the eternal inheritance in heaven.
The portion of God's kingdom and eternal life that belongs to those who hold fast to their faith.
Trust in God's word and promises even when they cannot be seen with human eyes.
The sure anchor for the soul, an expectation that God's promises will be fulfilled.
Security and stability that holds fast within the inner veil where Jesus has entered.
The high priest Jesus Christ who serves on our behalf before God according to the order of Melchizedek.
A mysterious king-priest from the Old Testament who foreshadowed Jesus' eternal priesthood.
The forgiveness of sins through God's grace, which believers have received through baptism and repentance.
To be born again to a new life in Christ with a purified soul.
The virtue that is shown when the Christian lives a life full of good works and love.
The land that produces only thistles, symbolizing the heart that has rejected God's word.
To turn away from the faith after having received knowledge of the truth, making it impossible to be restored to repentance.
Concepts and teachings about Christ that all Christians must build upon in order to grow in maturity.
